subject: Workplace Skills
title: Your Reputation Is Your Brand
description: A fast breakdown of Your Reputation Is Your Brand for builders.

hook.text: Your reputation enters rooms before you do and stays after you leave. People decide based on it.

buildup.text: Reputation forms from consistent behavior observed over time. One action rarely defines you, but patterns do.

discovery.text: You can shape your reputation deliberately by choosing what to be known for and acting accordingly.

twist.text: Repairing a damaged reputation takes three times longer than building one. Prevention matters more than cure.

climax.text: Ask three trusted colleagues what they'd say about you if asked. The gap between intent and perception is your work.

punchline.text: Your brand is what they say when you leave the room.

quiz.question: How is professional reputation best shaped?
options: Through consistent behavior aligned with what you want to be known for
By telling people directly what to think of you
